summary: The agent asked useful questions on exact demand satisfaction and contract timing, but missed key hidden slots on contract-length diversity, maximum distinct contracts, full-term coverage, and the optimization objective. It also became stuck repeatedly asking the same unresolved area-granularity question and never reached a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
